about_short_description.short_description: Health Harbor is a healthcare data platform designed to automate billing healthcare practices and RCM.

product.name: AI Agent
product.description: An AI system that autonomously calls health insurance representatives to perform benefits verifications, prior authorizations, and claim status inquiries.

product.name: AI Copilot
product.description: An AI tool that navigates insurance IVR systems and waits on hold before transferring the call to human staff to complete complex interactions.

product.name: Benefit Verifications
product.description: A service that checks patient insurance coverage details, including plan status, deductibles, and coverage for specific procedures and places of service.

product.name: Prior Authorizations
product.description: A service that requests, submits, and follows up on prior authorization requirements and statuses with health insurers.

product.name: Claim Follow-Up
product.description: A service that tracks the status of insurance claims, identifies reasons for denials or delays, and supports recovery of payments.
